description: Helmersbuurt 1887-1892 (Tweede Helmersstraat 79-97, Eerste Helmersstraat 1-27, Bosboom Toussaintstraat): 5.4-6.6 m red-brown brick fronts of a ground storey and four upper storeys under a cream cornice at about 15.2 m; three axes of white T-windows under segmental heads with a white keystone and white sills; a wrought-iron balconette on the centre axis of storeys 1-2; a square brick wall dormer with one light over the centre axis rising to about 18.5 m

wall-dormer.note: Tweede Helmersstraat 79-97: a square brick wall dormer over the centre axis, 15.3-18.7 m, one light, flat cap

door-left.note: house door on the left axis

rhythm.groundFloor: a house door and two windows over a low souterrain
rhythm.roofline: cream cornice at 15.2 m, a brick wall dormer over the centre axis
schemaLimits: the souterrain windows under the ground storey are not drawn

match.note: Tweede Helmersstraat 79-97 (1889), Eerste Helmersstraat 1-27 (1891): cornice 14.6-15.3 m on the strips; the skyline reads the brick wall dormer at 17.5-19 m (frontSkylineM)
